attribution: b7n0de — successor case of provenance-version-status-unrelated-status-field (CONFORMANCE.md rules 5 and 6, owner answer OQ-06 of 2026-10-26); every byte derived from the fixtures of provenance-version-status-unrelated-status-field, canonical bytes from RFC 8785 as in ADR 0002
rationale: Successor of provenance-version-status-unrelated-status-field, which stays in the corpus unchanged; same input and same expected value, corrected rationale. A provenance block may carry other fields ending in `_status` (run_status, scorer_status). The rule judges the named set harness_version, task_version and promptfoo_version (EVAL_CLAIM.md, "What the verifier checks, exactly") and nothing else, so these fields MUST NOT produce a finding. The old rationale said the rule follows the field suffix `_version`; neither the text nor the reference does: a future `foo_version` is judged only once the named set lists it.
